coreMemory.english: v. to gain knowledge or a skill
coreMemory.structure: learn to do /lɜːrn tu du/（学习做）；learn about /lɜːrn əbaʊt/（了解……）；learn from mistakes /lɜːrn frʌm mɪsteɪks/（从错误中学习）；learn by doing /lɜːrn baɪ duɪŋ/（从实践中学习）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ can to learn → ✅ can learn；❌ to learning → ✅ to learn

commonErrors.note: 情态动词 can 后直接接动词原形，不加 to。
不定式 to 后接动词原形；不要把不定式和 -ing 形式混合。
